title: Circuit Breaker
summary: Prevent cascading failures by tripping after repeated errors and probing recovery.
code: # Prevent cascading failures by tripping after repeated errors and probing recovery.

mutations.explanation: Skips required state initialization, raising AttributeError on failure check.
Requires an extra failure before tripping, failing to open at the exact threshold.

triggers: prevent cascading failures when an external dependency is unavailable or timing out
fail fast during outages and probe service recovery after a cooldown window
prompts: A payment service calls a third-party gateway that is experiencing an outage. Avoid hanging threads by failing fast after 5 timeouts, then probing every 30 seconds.
Design a client-side circuit breaker that wraps remote microservice calls to isolate intermittent network failures.
pitfalls: Failing to transition to HALF_OPEN after recovery time permanently blocks all future requests.
Resetting failure counts prematurely allows flaky services to oscillate indefinitely.
Not injecting the clock makes timeout testing slow and non-deterministic.

anchors.name: Rate Limiter vs Circuit Breaker
anchors.trick: Rate limiter protects the server from excess load; circuit breaker protects the client from dead dependencies.

mantra: Fail fast when broken, probe on cooldown, reset on success.
invariant: When failures >= threshold state becomes OPEN; when cooldown passes state probes HALF_OPEN.
